name: hv15_vmdel_lane-hv15-COMMIT
purpose: v5 lane leaf of the split VM delivery (v16 die: vmdel_<q><b> x32). Measured failure hv15_vmdel_lane-hv15-1d140b89b (v4c): TT -73.01 ps / TNS -14.6 ns / 419 D pins, FF +7.21, DRC 0; routed STA: every failing endpoint starts at an UNREGISTERED cross-lane status input (pcbad_all[3] -> |pcbad -> landing_fault -> fill_ok -> 512 seen flops + SRAM w_ce/r_ce: 548 ps behind the E pins = 2 OR levels + 4 placement buffers across the 257-um lane + 5 gates + 2 buffers to the macro pin; full*_all -> start_ok -> issue -> fill_ok -30.8; r2r -28.05 sticky -> u_payload w_ce on a macro clock 147 ps earlier than the register leaves); boundary clock 243-386 ps (spread 142 > 80: one 302-ps-slew leaf-driver net). Structural fix: (1) owner rule 19:50 applied to the last 27 unregistered pins: cross-lane status leaves the sending lane from an output flop and is captured in a pin flop at every lane (status latency 2 edges in every lane, reference ot_hbm_svc_static_landing/vm_delivery #(STATUS_LAT=2); cost block_ready / landing-fault response +2 edges, II unchanged); (2) explicit register-sink CTS clustering 16 sinks / 30 um (as the CLOSED 259.2x151.2 4-macro qfd_bl_lane_ce: spread 34 ps). (3) v5b after the v5 gate (81b4a4995, CTS STA reg->reg +2.5 ps: pcbad_q pin flop on the E face, 186 ps of wire buffers to the W/S control corner + 4-level OR): the 8-lane AND/OR reduction sits in front of the pin flop (3 status flops, not 24) and full0_all/full1_all/pcbad_all move to the W face beside begin/start. Outline 257.04x151.2 kept. Bench: production (SLAT=2) + LAT=2 lockstep equivalence vs the STATUS_LAT=2 reference; mutants group-select, SRAM slot, late reset release, status pin flops bypassed FAIL (Icarus 11 and 12).
